reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: good price, reliable and fast speed, didn't get hot on me yet
reviews.comment: Maybe too soon to say it is all good, but got this because it was the cheapest 2TB SSD drive I found on amazon that had a good reputation. I use this with an external docking stage, so does not get hot at all since it sticks out and does air flows on it.  I have not had any data loss with it. It is good quality, my Mac was able to detect it very easy and was 100% compatible with it. In comparison to regular SATA drives, this for sure has a much higher and faster response time, and files copy rather fast to it, no complaints.  I mainly use it for backup purposes not as a working drive, so thus far works very reliability and if holds up in a few months I'll probably get another one.
reviews.author: Adren

reviews.title: Friendly reminder, this is a SATA SSD
reviews.comment:
This "KingSpec NT Series 2TB M.2 2280 SATA SSD - Not Compatible with NVMe Socket, Sata3 6Gb/s Internal Solid State Drive, for Ultrabook & Laptop & Desktop" is very economical compared to its listed competitors so that is a huge benefit if you were to have a slot that fits this type of storage.
Do keep in mind that this is a SATA SSD. It is not NVME which is something you might overlook because it appears in the search results.
I tried to get this to work with an NVME socket, because that's what I searched for. But this is not an NVME product, it is a SATA product. This is not compatible with NVME M.2 2280 sockets.
So, installation works great in a SATA M.2 2280 sockets, as this is a SATA SSD. Do not attempt to get this working in an NVME socket, as it is made for SATA. Even though when searching for "nvme 2tb m.2 2280" this shows up in the top 3 results as the cheapest of them all.
